compendium.summary: Split encounters, protect objectives and create safe lanes.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
tactics: The Sickening Radiance pairing needs a separate concentration holder for each spell. Put the hazard in place before sealing the area; do not assume you can target freely through an invisible barrier.
A Faithful Hound can supply a non-concentration hazard, but its bite only threatens enemies within 5 feet. Geometry must actually keep the target there.
Plan escape routes and counters before committing both spells. Teleportation, applicable spell effects, Disintegrate and concentration attacks can defeat the setup.
